note: Converted from the legacy personal-corpus scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) during the measure/markdown-render/knowledge-docs fold-in, 2026-07-07. Routing corpus for the research-methods description. Positives span the six question-classes (optimize / debug-regression / contribution / tune / stress-test) in imperative, symptom, and named-technique phrasings. Negatives are the fenced neighbors: bare web/literature lookup (no system, no scorer), artifact review (the *-reviewer agents), authoring/building (the *-author skills / builder), and the nearest IMPROVE-FAMILY siblings whose 'make X better' overlaps but is owned elsewhere (linguistic-techniques improves prompt language, rubric-forge tightens anchors, loop-rules owns stopping predicates) — these three run no measured scorer loop, so they are researcher's neighbors, not its work. Known accepted-leak class (2026-07-19, discovered during a full scribe /eval-run run alongside the knowledge-forge retirement, kimgranlund/claude-plugins#58): n13 ('make this prompt or agent more effective') is forced onto research-methods by a blind judge on scribe's per-plugin menu — its true owner (linguistic-techniques) lives in the forge plugin, off this menu; the description's own fence is truthful, do not weaken it to chase this.
